planning.scope: Supported axis naming, labelled numeric scales and editable graph construction from three prescribed model datasets; no compulsory line/velocity/function calculation.
planning.evidenceLimits: Supported component of graph production from given fictional records, not full physical inquiry, free scale design, independent instrument operation, unsupported formal game process/rubric, personal mastery, retention or efficacy.
planning.curriculumVsDesign: Historical OPH2014 S1 supports investigation/result representation broadly. Exact project roles/prerequisitegroups/UI/finite task bounds remain frozen project design, not quoted curricular mandates.
planning.assetProvenance: Original domain SVGs; actual supplied named character PNG unchanged. No protected source figures/prose copied, invented poses or vector mascot replacement.

extensions.timing: Manual drawing steps, not physical/model elapsed time or speed measurement.
extensions.privacy: Transient local prescribed models/responses only; no storage/network/telemetry/personalevidence.
extensions.feedback: Both input/change, explicit current-visible check, scoped verdict validity; support/reorder/scale preserves unchanged meaning.
